name: MH3G #8 item-pouch decrement candidate entry
purpose_zh: 在玩家正常消耗一件背包道具时，验证候选数量变更函数入口的 r4 为道具 ID、r5 为 0xFFFFFFFF（-1）、r6 为 4 字节槽数组、r7 为槽数。只记录，不改寄存器或内存。
purpose_en: During one normal pouch-item consumption, prove that the candidate mutator receives item ID in r4, 0xFFFFFFFF (-1) in r5, a four-byte slot array in r6, and its count in r7. Record only; do not alter registers or memory.
operator_steps_zh: 进入稳定任务场景，准备一个数量至少为 2、使用后会减少 1 的普通背包道具。
启动 tracer 后立即只使用一次该道具，不要同时整理、丢弃或领取其他物品。
只有 JSONL 的命中动作与本次使用一致、r5=0xFFFFFFFF，且 r6 快照包含该道具槽时，才把 delta 参数映射视为运行时成立。
operator_steps_en: Enter a stable quest scene with a normal pouch item whose quantity is at least two and decreases by one on use.
After starting the tracer, use that item exactly once without sorting, discarding, or receiving another item.
Treat the delta mapping as runtime-proven only when the JSONL hit corresponds to that action, r5 is 0xFFFFFFFF, and the r6 snapshot contains the item slot.
